versions.content: {DRAFT} When StbM updates the Main Time Tuple (refer to [SWS_StbM_00433]), then the StbM shall immediately update the Fallback Virtual Local Time of the Main Time Triple (TV Fallback_Main ) by the current value of the Fallback Virtual Local Time . If Fallback Virtual Local Time could not be determined (e.g., the underlying hardware counter has not been activated yet), when the Main Time Triple is up- dated, then the StbM shall set the Fallback Virtual Local Time of the Main Time Triple (TV Fallback_Main ) to 0.
